title: Horned Figure by the Lake
description: A black horned silhouette with pink tears sits on a rock in dark water, one hand touching a flowering tree branch with yellow blossoms. The scene shows a pink swirling sky with blue eyes, broken black shapes above, glowing blue orbs containing couples, golden fish, green plants, and tall dark stones with painted marks, all reflected in the calm water.
prompt: A black horned silhouette figure with pink tears sits on a rock in dark water touching a branch of a flowering tree that has yellow blossoms and green leaves. The night scene shows a pink swirling sky with floating blue eyes, broken black shapes at the top, glowing blue orbs in the water that contain couples, golden fish swimming, green water plants, and tall dark stones covered in painted marks, with everything reflected in the calm lake surface.
